text: Bombas runs its store on Shopify Plus after migrating off Adobe Commerce (Magento), which let it do mass product uploads across channels from one back end.

evidence.quote: mass product uploads quickly, across multiple ecommerce channels, using a back-end system

text: Bombas' Shopify case study states the Magento to Shopify Plus migration is saving Bombas 108,000 dollars a year in platform costs.

evidence.quote: Bombas migrated for site stability, and is also saving $108,000 a year in platform costs

text: A live Bombas job posting names Meta and AppLovin as the paid channels its Social Marketing Manager optimizes day to day.

evidence.quote: You will own the day-to-day tactical optimization of channels like Meta and Applovin

text: The same posting requires comfort working in Looker for analytics on top of paid social data.

evidence.quote: Analytical rigor, with comfort working in Looker and excel, analyzing large datasets

text: The posting lists Feedonomics feed management experience as a plus, suggesting Bombas uses or is evaluating Feedonomics for product feeds.

evidence.quote: Experience with feed management, especially Feedonomics is a plus

text: Bombas' new physical stores run on Shopify's Leap integration, which Shopify says handles store setup end to end.

evidence.quote: takes care of everything: location sourcing, store design, operational setup, marketing, analytics

text: Bombas uses freight and logistics platform Flexport, including its shipment visibility and reporting tools, for international distribution.
